title: Purchase Bill
context: Finance › Payment Flow (Purchase Bill to Vendor Payment) › Purchase Bill

cards.title: Architecture, database entity mappings, and schema structure of fPurchaseBill
cards.body:
fPurchaseBill is the primary accounts payable invoice entry interface operating within the FI module.
Header attributes persist in Finance.FPurchaseBillMain with unique key DocNo and DocumentYearlyNo.
Line item details map to Finance.FPurchaseBillDetail linked by PurchaseBillDetailId foreign keys.
Tax line distributions persist within the shared table Finance.TDCTransactionDetail.
Advance clearance allocations write to Finance.FAdvanceAdjustDetail capturing AdvanceVoucherId and AdjustedAmount.
Payment schedule breakdowns are generated into Finance.FPaymentScheduleDetail with due dates.
Entity state transitions are governed by DocumentStatus flags Initial, Release, and Authorized.
Optimistic concurrency relies on ModifiedDate and ModifiedBy columns verified during save execution.
Shared custom fields interface through masterdata.customfieldssave during transaction commit.
Foreign key constraints enforce referential integrity against vendor, item, and finance book master tables.
Audit triggers record modification history in Finance.FPurchaseBillAuditDetail for compliance tracking.
Atomic transaction boundaries ensure invoice headers and detail lines commit synchronously without partial writes.
Primary keys DocNo and DocumentYearlyNo maintain clustered index structures for high-speed retrieval.
Foreign key relationships bind line items to inventory receipt details and purchase order lines.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.
Database triggers intercept unauthorized data manipulation attempts and enforce strict referential boundaries across schemas.

cards.body:

Search queries invoke Finance.PBPBSearchData to return filtered invoice headers based on user criteria.
Record loading executes through Finance.PBPBLoadData and Finance.PBPBFillValuesPOWise routines.
Lookup dropdowns and dependent filters populate using Finance.PBPBFillValuesDependent procedures.
Vendor profile parameters load through GlobalData.VendorLocationSelect lookup procedures.
Account balances for advance matching retrieve via Finance.AccountOpening stored procedures.
Record deletion is governed by Finance.PBPBDelete which checks downstream payment and voucher references.
Custom validation routines execute through external handlers ODTDispatchChallan.ProcedureName.
Item accounting definitions resolve dynamically through masterdata.ItemAccountDetail procedures.
Stored procedures return structured error codes handled by the application exception layer.
All persistence procedures execute within serialized transaction blocks to maintain data consistency.
Diagnostic shortcuts Ctrl+Alt+G rebuild GST posting distributions from line item records directly.
Persistence procedures utilize table-valued parameters for efficient line item insertions.
Structured catch blocks capture relational database errors and execute explicit transaction rollbacks.
Execution plans are cached by the relational database engine to optimize throughput under heavy load.
Audit procedures log execution duration and calling user credentials for security reviews.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.

cards.title: Validation logic, Boolean conditions, and error triggers in fPurchaseBill
cards.body:
fPurchaseBill enforces strict business rules prior to executing persistence routines in the database.
VendorBillDate > DocumentDate raises an immediate validation error stopping execution on save.
PassingAmount > VendorBillAmount aborts processing to prevent over-billing errors across lines.
SGST or CGST applied to an interstate transaction triggers geographic tax mismatch exceptions.
IGST applied to an intrastate transaction triggers geographic tax validation refusal.
DocumentStatus == Authorized halts save attempts with Authorized entry can't be updated.
Selecting a VendorBillNo already recorded for the vendor fires duplicate invoice errors.
Unmatched currencies across multiple selected GRN references aborts the transaction.
AdjustingAmount > BalanceAmount on advance rows fires advance allocation exceptions.
Validation checks execute sequentially within client validation before invoking backend procedures.
Division lock flags query masterdata.mCalendarPeriod to prevent saving into closed accounting periods.
Structured error messages identify the exact line item and column violating business constraints.
Server procedures re-verify all Boolean conditions to ensure data integrity against direct API calls.
Failed checks raise custom error codes mapped to localized user error messages in the interface.
Rollback handlers reverse all intermediate variable states when any rule triggers an exception.

cards.title: Child record mutation logic, atomic transactions, and status cascades
cards.body:
Transaction modifications execute a delete-and-reinsert pattern for detail line items in the database.
Existing records in Finance.FPurchaseBillDetail are purged and regenerated from current inputs.
Atomic transaction scopes ensure header updates and detail re-insertions commit together.
Cascade routines update BilledQty on Inventory.IGRNDetail records to track warehouse receipt consumption.
Advance adjustment records decrement open balances on referenced advance vouchers in Finance.
Authorization transitions source GRN records from Unbilled to Billed status automatically.
If transaction failure occurs, all detail deletions and balance updates roll back completely.
Historical audit tables capture prior row states before detail line replacement executes.
Concurrency timestamps prevent detail replacement if another user modified the document.
Cascade handlers ensure accounts payable sub-ledgers reflect current net liabilities accurately.
Line item replacement commits synchronously with document header updates within a single transaction.
This mutation logic guarantees that parent receipts and child bills remain perfectly synchronized.
Detail line replacement executes synchronously with parent document updates in the database.
Foreign key constraints ensure orphaned child rows cannot persist after update execution.
Cascade routines update BilledQty across inventory tables within the primary transaction boundary.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.

cards.title: General Ledger posting procedures, voucher generation, and tax distribution
cards.body:
Document authorization executes General Ledger posting via Finance.PBPBFinancePosting in the database.
Valued invoice lines debit inventory clearing accounts or departmental expense accounts.
The vendor control payable account is credited with the total invoice payable value.
Input tax lines write to discrete CGST, SGST, or IGST input ledger accounts based on state registration.
Account Determination Rules (ARD) resolve ledger accounts based on item sub groups and vendor locations.
Generated voucher entries write to Finance.FJournalMaster and Finance.FJournalDetail tables.
Posted voucher numbers write back to FPurchaseBillMain to establish permanent audit lineage.
Diagnostic shortcuts Ctrl+Alt+V invoke voucher regeneration scripts for authorized records.
Rollback handlers reverse ledger postings if tax distribution generation encounters database errors.
Financial postings maintain double-entry balancing invariants between clearing and payable ledgers.
Sub-ledger posting updates vendor aging tables to support payment planning and credit term tracking.
This posting interface ensures exact synchronization between purchasing bills and the General Ledger.
Clearing accounts reconcile input tax credits against central goods and services tax ledgers.
Rollback handlers ensure ledger vouchers reverse cleanly if tax calculation errors occur.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.
